definitions.gloss: a member (of a group or organization)
definitions.explanation: One person who belongs to a group, team, or organization.

examples.japanese: チームの{一員|いちいん}になる。
examples.english: I become a member of the team.

examples.japanese: {社会|しゃかい}の{一員|いちいん}として{責任|せきにん}を{果|は}たす。
examples.english: I fulfill my responsibility as a member of society.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}の{一員|いちいん}として{迎|むか}え{入|い}れる。
examples.english: We welcome them as a member of the family.

notes:
{一員|いちいん} emphasizes being part of a larger group.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- チームの{一員|いちいん}: a member of the team
- {社会|しゃかい}の{一員|いちいん}: a member of society
- {家族|かぞく}の{一員|いちいん}: a member of the family
- {組織|そしき}の{一員|いちいん}: a member of the organization
- {一員|いちいん}として: as a member

USAGE:
This word emphasizes belonging to and being part of a group, rather than just being counted as a number. It often carries a sense of responsibility or solidarity.
